source_name: Post Quantum PCI Use Cases: ATM and POS Card Capture; ATM and POS Setup with Backend Acquiring Systems
requirement: Migrate Terminal Master Keys (TMK) and Terminal PIN Keys (TPK) from Triple-DES to AES to mitigate quantum vulnerabilities in PIN encryption.
evidence_quote: The obvious solution is to migrate the TMK and TPK from Triple- DES to AES. This would entail the use of ISO PIN block 4 in EPPs and POS devices as well as acquiring systems.
evidence_location: Use Case 5: ATM and POS Card Capture > Online PIN Verification > Mitigation Techniques

source_name: Post Quantum PCI Use Cases: ATM and POS Card Capture; ATM and POS Setup with Backend Acquiring Systems
requirement: Update EPP or POS manufacturer certificates to quantum-safe algorithms or modify the Remote Key Loading protocol to use quantum-safe cryptography.
evidence_quote: The EPP or POS manufacturer would need to change the certificates to be quantum-safe or otherwise change the protocol to use a quantum- safe protocol.
evidence_location: Use Case 6: ATM and POS Setup With Backend Acquiring Systems > Remote Key Loading > Mitigation Techniques

source_name: Post Quantum PCI Use Cases: ATM and POS Card Capture; ATM and POS Setup with Backend Acquiring Systems
requirement: Ensure the bootloader of EPP or POS devices uses quantum-secure cryptography and that implemented algorithms are resistant to side-channel attacks per PCI PTS.
evidence_quote: Note that for remote key loading, the bootloader of the EPP or POS must also use quantum secure cryptography and the implemented quantum secure encryption algorithms must be resistant to side-channel attacks in accordance with PCI PTS.
evidence_location: Use Case 6: ATM and POS Setup With Backend Acquiring Systems > Remote Key Loading > Mitigation Techniques
